scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof and normalized Hopf coefficient reproduced by standalone symbolic checks; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Global nonexistence of strictly positive periodic orbits at or above the adaptation cutoff, and sharpness only in a parameter-uniform sense. Does not establish global convergence, stochastic analogues, or optimal thresholds at every fixed Allee strength. Potential subsumption by a broader 2017 generalized-Dulac result is an unresolved primary-source access risk.
title: Sharp parameter-uniform oscillation cutoff in a weak-Allee liquidity–profit flow
